meta.name: Pop Art Lottie Generator Knowledgebase
meta.description: Comprehensive knowledgebase for generating Lottie-compatible Pop Art animations

rules: Uniform, heavy black strokes (3px to 8px standard scaling)
Clean round caps and joins to prevent artifacting
linework.lottie_handling: Rendered as solid vector stroke paths with round lineCap: 'round' and lineJoin: 'round'

rules: Pure primary colors (saturated Cyan, Magenta, Yellow)
Avoid soft gradients - use solid fills only
color_palette.lottie_handling: Apply as solid fill objects. No gradient support.

rules: Simulate offset printing using Ben-Day dots or diagonal halftone lines
CRITICAL: Massive dot grids destroy Lottie performance
Replace with scalable repeating vector SVG patterns or striping
Linear 45-degree diagonal hash marks spaced 6px apart preferred

pattern_types.name: vertical_stripes
pattern_types.description: Vertical parallel lines for speed lines

pattern_types.name: ben_day_dots
pattern_types.performance: warning - only use for small areas

shading_texture.lottie_handling: Use SVG pattern fills or pre-rendered vector mask strokes

rules: Convert text to outlines before Lottie export
typography.lottie_handling: Convert all text to vector paths (bezier curves). Store as shape layer with no font reference.

path_optimization.guidance: Keep vertices to minimum. Complex character should not exceed 500 vector nodes total.
path_optimization.violation_impact: Causes lag during web runtime rendering

layer_nesting.guidance: Limit nesting to 3 levels deep for clean JSON parsing
layer_nesting.violation_impact: Slow JSON parsing and memory overhead

animation_performance.reasoning: Mimics traditional hand-drawn comic or cell animation pacing
animation_performance.interpolation: Sharp, snappy easing curves. Avoid linear movement.

loop_structure.guidance: Ensure frame 0 and final frame have identical element positions/properties for seamless loop

concept_overview.title: The Retro Ring of Anxiety
concept_overview.description: A classic 1960s rotary telephone violently shakes on a flat surface while an explosive 'RING!' sound effect bursts from the receiver. The entire animation loops flawlessly every 48 frames (2 seconds at 24fps).

palette_textures.shadow_texture: Linear 45-degree diagonal black hash marks spaced 6px apart (simulated fast-rendering halftone)

animation_segments.description: Receiver_Group scales up and down rapidly by 5% on high-frequency loop to simulate vibration
FX_Burst_Group opacity snaps 0% → 100%. Scale pops 50% → 110% using easing [0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275], settles back to 100% by frame 16
Rotary_Dial spins 45° clockwise and snaps back. Text_Element oscillates along path warp
Elements ease back to exact Frame 0 positions for seamless loop

motion_keyframes.seamless_loop_check: PASS - Frame 0 and Frame 48 have identical element states

constraint_validation_rules.error_message: Total vector nodes exceed Lottie performance threshold
Nesting depth exceeds 3 levels - simplify hierarchy
Animation does not loop seamlessly - frame 0 and final frame must be identical
Framerate should be 24 or 30 fps for comic animation feel
Detected unsupported Lottie feature - remove and rebuild with supported features
Color palette should use pure, saturated primary colors
Text must be converted to vector paths - remove font dependencies
Linework stroke width should be between 3px and 8px for Pop Art aesthetic
